scope: development oracle independently computed from source CSVs; not a model-quality evaluation

cases.prompt: 目前去重後有幾場比賽？
cases.source_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM catalog
cases.target_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM matches

cases.prompt: 去重後共有幾筆逐拍標註？
cases.source_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM annotations
cases.target_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM shots

cases.source_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT match_name,set_no,rally FROM annotations GROUP BY match_name,set_no,rally)
cases.target_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM rallies

cases.source_sql: SELECT year,COUNT(*) AS n FROM catalog GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
cases.target_sql: SELECT year,COUNT(*) AS n FROM matches GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

cases.prompt: 列出 2019 福州公開賽男單決賽的 A/B 球員姓名。
2019 福州公開賽男單決賽共有幾筆逐拍標註？
cases.source_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM annotations WHERE match_name='Kento_MOMOTA_CHOU_Tien_Chen_Fuzhou_Open_2019_Finals'
cases.target_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM shots WHERE match_name='Kento_MOMOTA_CHOU_Tien_Chen_Fuzhou_Open_2019_Finals'

cases.prompt: 比較 2019 福州公開賽男單決賽兩位球員的出手數與比例並畫長條圖，player 使用 A/B。
cases.source_sql: SELECT player,COUNT(*) AS n,ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annotations WHERE match_name='Kento_MOMOTA_CHOU_Tien_Chen_Fuzhou_Open_2019_Finals'),2) AS pct FROM annotations WHERE match_name='Kento_MOMOTA_CHOU_Tien_Chen_Fuzhou_Open_2019_Finals' GROUP BY player ORDER BY player
cases.target_sql: SELECT player,COUNT(*) AS n,ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shots WHERE match_name='Kento_MOMOTA_CHOU_Tien_Chen_Fuzhou_Open_2019_Finals'),2) AS pct FROM shots WHERE match_name='Kento_MOMOTA_CHOU_Tien_Chen_Fuzhou_Open_2019_Finals' GROUP BY player ORDER BY player

cases.prompt: 2022 年所有比賽各球種有幾筆標註？
cases.source_sql: SELECT s.type,COUNT(*) AS n FROM annotations s JOIN catalog m ON m.name=s.match_name WHERE m.year=2022 GROUP BY s.type ORDER BY s.type
cases.target_sql: SELECT s.type,COUNT(*) AS n FROM shots s JOIN matches m ON m.name=s.match_name WHERE m.year=2022 GROUP BY s.type ORDER BY s.type

cases.prompt: 2019 福州決賽 A/B 各有幾拍標記為落地致勝？
cases.source_sql: SELECT player,COUNT(*) AS n FROM annotations WHERE match_name='Kento_MOMOTA_CHOU_Tien_Chen_Fuzhou_Open_2019_Finals' AND win_reason='落地致勝' GROUP BY player ORDER BY player
cases.target_sql: SELECT player,COUNT(*) AS n FROM shots WHERE match_name='Kento_MOMOTA_CHOU_Tien_Chen_Fuzhou_Open_2019_Finals' AND win_reason='落地致勝' GROUP BY player ORDER BY player

cases.prompt: 有幾場比賽提供外部影片連結？
cases.source_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM catalog WHERE video_url IS NOT NULL
cases.target_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM matches WHERE video_url IS NOT NULL

cases.prompt: 列出 2019 福州決賽的原始影片網址。
有幾個已具本機可播放影片的回合？
cases.target_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM rallies WHERE has_video=1

cases.prompt: 兩份來源共有幾場重疊比賽？
cases.source_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT name FROM source_matches GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
cases.target_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT match_name FROM match_sources GROUP BY match_name HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

cases.prompt: 逐拍來源標註中去除了幾筆重複？
cases.source_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_shots)-(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annotations) AS n
cases.target_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shot_sources)-(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shots) AS n

cases.prompt: 各資料來源有幾筆原始逐拍標註？
cases.source_sql: SELECT dataset,COUNT(*) AS n FROM source_shots GROUP BY dataset ORDER BY dataset
cases.target_sql: SELECT dataset,COUNT(*) AS n FROM shot_sources GROUP BY dataset ORDER BY dataset

cases.prompt: 有幾組拍號相同但內容不同的標註？
cases.source_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT match_name,set_no,rally,ball_round FROM annotations GROUP BY match_name,set_no,rally,ball_round HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
cases.target_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM data_quality_issues WHERE code='repeated_shot_number'
